name: Single-Arm Sled Push
instructions: Load the sled and stand behind it, gripping only one of the high handles with one hand.
Lean your body weight forward into the sled at roughly a 45-degree angle, keeping a neutral spine.
Brace your core hard to resist your torso twisting under the one-sided load.
Drive through the balls of your feet with short, powerful steps to push the sled forward.
Keep the pushing arm firm as a stabilizer without locking the elbow.
Cover the set distance or time, then repeat leading with the opposite arm.
